speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Master Shakespeare. The boy was here before noon, with one wrapper and a sentence he was afraid to improve. I have written it in the list. I read it back. That is the way, since shouting after me in the yard stopped being useful.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Read it. I did not bring a second copy. If the boy dropped a word, I would rather hear the word you have than the word I hope you have.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: The lovers are played on Saturday. That is the four lines, boiled down to the sentence a horse can carry. The letter of the sixteenth is in the same tying, and the six lines from the twenty-fourth. I am not reading those aloud in a taproom. They were written when they were written.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good. The six are not written again. The letter already lays the Christmas money, and it does not name the parts to a room. I will not add a line to hurry her, and I will not put sixty shillings in this wrapper. That is another Thursday.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twopence the letter, sixpence the parcel, and nothing for a speech in the doorway. Three papers and one tying is a letter. You have not made it a parcel. Twelve hours to Wycombe if the way's dry. That figure is how I measure a road. It is not a promise about this one.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Twopence. Here. There is no visit hiding in the sheet, and no pack. The pack is the eighteenth. This Thursday is the play, and the play is the line you just read.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: Twopence is in the list. I will say the line once more, so the list and the man agree. The lovers are played on Saturday. After that, your paper, not my improvements.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not improve it. She knows you better than she knows my haste. I have no cheeses to add, and I am not asking you what the road will be.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: I can carry the letter. I cannot make her read what you meant instead. The horses are watered when they are watered. A poet being precise does not move a hoof.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then I will stop being precise. Saturday is written. The old papers are in the same tying. That is the business.

speaker: thomas_hobbins
text: I have your twopence. I have your line. Go home. The Bell is full of men who think a carrier is a confessor, and I am not one.
